# Bunchasake

> Bunchasake is a brand builder and growth partner: a Vietnamese studio working between Vietnam and Italy, online with clients anywhere, in Vietnamese and English. We turn a founder's story into a brand and set up a social media automation system the client's own team runs. Contact: hello@bunchasake.com

Promise: "You run the business. We grow the brand."

## Who we work with
- Vietnamese business owners abroad (nail salons, restaurants and other owner-run businesses in the US, Canada, Australia and Europe)
- Vietnamese brands that want to enter international markets

## How we work
Four steps, and the client approves after each one: Listening (a 60-minute conversation with the founder, customer and competitor research), Positioning (who the brand is, who it is for, how it is different, the brand story), Identity (name if needed, logo, colours, typography, voice, guidelines), Touchpoints (website, signage, cards, social media templates).

Packages: Start (new businesses), Build (the full four steps), Refresh (an existing brand that feels dated). The quote comes after the first conversation.

Add-on, Social Media Automation: your own AI assistant trained on the brand voice, a 30-day content calendar, AI drafts that you approve, automatic scheduling on Facebook, Instagram and TikTok, and automatic inbox replies. We set up the system; your team runs it.

## Services
- [Nail salons](https://bunchasake.com/nail-salon-brand-marketing/): A Vietnamese studio building brands for Vietnamese-owned nail salons abroad: logo, colours, voice, menu, signage and a social media system your team runs.
- [Restaurants & food](https://bunchasake.com/restaurant-brand-marketing/): A Vietnamese marketing agency for restaurants: we turn the story behind your food into a brand, a menu and a social media system your team runs.
- [Vietnamese businesses abroad](https://bunchasake.com/vietnamese-diaspora-brand-marketing/): A Vietnamese studio that builds the brand and sets up social media for Vietnamese business owners abroad, in English and Vietnamese.
- [Vietnamese brands going global](https://bunchasake.com/international-brand-marketing-vietnam/): We help Vietnamese brands enter Europe and the US: positioning for the new market, identity, English brand voice and a website buyers abroad understand.
- [Social media automation](https://bunchasake.com/social-media-automation/): We build your social media system once: an AI assistant in your brand voice, a 30-day calendar, scheduling and inbox replies. Your own team runs it.
- [Automation for nail salons](https://bunchasake.com/social-media-automation-for-nail-salons/): Social media automation for nail salons: an AI assistant, a 30-day calendar, drafts you approve, scheduled posts and inbox replies. We set it up, you run it.
- [Automation for restaurants](https://bunchasake.com/social-media-automation-for-restaurants/): Social media automation for restaurants: an AI assistant, a 30-day calendar, drafts you approve, scheduled posts and inbox replies. Your team runs it.

## Guides
- [How to get more nail clients, starting with what people see first](https://bunchasake.com/blog/how-to-get-more-nail-clients/): How to get more nail clients, honestly. What people check before they book, a prioritised action list and a first 30 days checklist for salon owners.
- [25 nail salon social media content ideas you can copy this week](https://bunchasake.com/blog/nail-salon-social-media-content-ideas/): Five content pillars, 25 post ideas with examples, a weekly posting rhythm and caption tips for nail salons on Facebook, Instagram and TikTok.
- [Nail salon Instagram content ideas, from your bio to a 2-week plan](https://bunchasake.com/blog/nail-salon-instagram-content-ideas/): What your salon's Instagram profile needs, 12 Reels ideas with hooks, carousel and Stories routines, hashtag basics and a 2-week plan to copy.
- [Google Business Profile for nail salon owners, a do-it-yourself guide](https://bunchasake.com/blog/google-business-profile-for-nail-salons/): A do-it-yourself guide to Google Business Profile for a nail salon, from categories, hours, services and photos to reviews, with reply templates.
- [How to market a Vietnamese restaurant to the whole neighbourhood, not only the community](https://bunchasake.com/blog/how-to-market-a-vietnamese-restaurant/): How to market a Vietnamese restaurant to local diners. Your story, a menu newcomers can read, Google basics, bilingual posts, reviews and a 90-day plan.
- [24 restaurant Instagram content ideas a busy kitchen can actually make](https://bunchasake.com/blog/restaurant-instagram-content-ideas/): 24 restaurant Instagram content ideas with caption examples, a simple way to film food with a phone, Stories routines for service and a 2-week plan.
- [Bilingual Vietnamese English marketing, a practical guide for business owners abroad](https://bunchasake.com/blog/bilingual-marketing-for-vietnamese-businesses-abroad/): A practical guide to bilingual Vietnamese English marketing. Which language goes where, one brand voice in two languages, and a weekly workflow.
